findings.title: A history of address ends at the smallest sound
findings.claim: The surah's wider movement among calls, silences, testimony, and disputed speech arrives at 19:98 as a sensory endpoint: the generations once made present through their worldly display can no longer be found even as one person or heard as the faintest sound.
findings.mechanism: The close repeats the earlier-generation destruction wording of 19:74, where those generations are described as having greater furnishings and appearance, then changes the question from their former prominence to whether any person or sound remains perceptible. The wider cries of destroyed generations in 38:3 and the call to hear signs among former dwellings in 32:26 give the close an audible contrast; 69:8 supplies a parallel question about whether any remnant can be seen. Returning through 19:98's generation, sensing, hearing, and faint-sound words, these contexts make the ending a search for the minimum human or acoustic trace rather than a bare repetition of a destruction count.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader hears the movement from former prominence and cries to a closing test at the edge of perception: whether even one person or one faint sound is still there.
findings.containment: The plain claim remains that many generations were destroyed and the question asks whether any one of them can be sensed or any faint sound heard from them. The wider echoes do not establish that every material trace or dwelling vanished, do not identify all referenced communities as one group, and do not supply target morphology beyond the exact Arabic surfaces in the packet.

epistemic.reason: The cross-run publication is trusted and its five focus anchors resolve through the supplied alignment to exact focus QAC occurrences. branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey kaybolma, bozulma, ölüm veya ortadan kalkma sonucunda varlığını ya da işlevini yitirir.
branch_activations.carrier: أَهْلَكْنَا carries the destruction that brings the earlier generations to an end.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 19:74 surface repeats the earlier-generation destruction formula and adds that those people had greater furnishings and appearance.
branch_activations.activation: The wider repetition returns through the focus's destruction verb and sets the earlier display against the present question of what remains perceptible.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The final question follows a remembered act of destruction by testing whether any human presence or faint sound remains.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not infer that 19:74 and 19:98 name one identical historical group or that all material traces disappeared.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Geçişli kullanımda bir kişi veya güç başka bir şeyi yok oluş ya da ağır bozulma sonucuna sürükler.
branch_activations.carrier: The first-person plural causative form أَهْلَكْنَا states that the generations were brought to destruction.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 19:74 gives the earlier wider occurrence of the same destruction formula alongside the generations' greater worldly display.
branch_activations.activation: The repeated caused-destruction act meets the later sensory question, turning the earlier generations' lost prominence into the endpoint of a search for any detectable person or sound.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Destruction is heard as the transition from a once conspicuous population to no perceptible individual or faint voice at the close.
branch_activations.boundary: The relation adds no claim about why each wider group was destroyed or whether their dwellings remained.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: aynı çağın insanları veya kuşak dönemi
branch_activations.facet_statement: Aynı zaman diliminde birlikte yaşayan insan topluluğu.
branch_activations.carrier: قَرْنٍ presents the counted people as a generation living in one period.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The earlier 19:74 occurrence gives the same destroyed-generation frame and contrasts the generations' former material display with the warned audience.
branch_activations.activation: The return of the generation wording makes the last ayah recall a previously displayed population before turning to whether even one of its people can now be perceived.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The final sensory question measures the disappearance of a once-present cohort at the scale of a single person.
branch_activations.boundary: No fixed length in years is assigned to a generation, and the two verses are not asserted to identify the same people.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Dış dünyadaki bir şeyi bir duyu aracılığıyla algılama.
branch_activations.carrier: تُحِسُّ asks whether any of the destroyed people can be perceived through a sense.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 69:8 surface asks whether any remnant of the destroyed people can be seen.
branch_activations.activation: The wider visual remainder-question meets the focus's more general sensing question and makes the close a test of sensory presence after destruction.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus's endpoint concerns whether any person is perceptible, not only whether a large population once existed.
branch_activations.boundary: The parallel does not equate the referenced communities or claim that all forms of evidence vanished.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Duyusal algıdan hareketle bir şeyin varlığını bilme, görme veya bulma.
branch_activations.carrier: In تُحِسُّ, sensing can establish whether something is present or findable.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 69:8 asks whether any remnant can be seen after the destruction it has just described.
branch_activations.activation: The outside question about seeing a remainder returns through the focus's query about sensing one individual, moving the ending from historic quantity to detectable existence.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The reader encounters the close as a search for evidence that any person is still present to the senses.
branch_activations.boundary: This is sensory finding in context, not unrestricted knowledge or a claim about an unseen afterlife.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: görülmeden fark edilen hafif ses veya gizli hareket
branch_activations.facet_statement: Kaynağı görülmeden işitilen hafif veya gizli ses.
branch_activations.carrier: تُحِسُّ carries the possibility of detecting a faint or hidden sound without seeing its source.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The exact 38:3 surface says that earlier destroyed generations cried out too late.
branch_activations.activation: Their wider cry supplies an audible contrast to the focus's question about whether any person can now be sensed and whether a faint sound remains.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The close follows the possibility of a late cry with the more severe endpoint of no detectable remnant from those destroyed.
branch_activations.boundary: The contrast does not establish the same historical community in both verses or claim that the focus repeats the cry scene.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Ses, kulak aracılığıyla fark edilir ve işitsel algıya dönüşür.
branch_activations.carrier: تَسْمَعُ asks whether a sound from the earlier generations reaches the hearer.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 32:26 surface places people walking among former dwellings and closes by asking whether they hear.
branch_activations.activation: The wider appeal to hear the signs of former dwellings returns through the focus's hearing verb, reversing the direction from the living who should hear history to the missing people whose sound can no longer be heard.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The close lets the reader hear a movement from a living audience's encounter with history to the absence of a voice from the destroyed generations.
branch_activations.boundary: The target morphology is not supplied, so the relation stays at the exact surface question about hearing and does not assert a separate compliance sense.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: gizli veya uzaktan gelen hafif ses
branch_activations.facet_statement: Ses işitilir, ancak gizli, uzaktan gelen veya şiddetli olmayan bir nitelik taşır.
branch_activations.carrier: رِكْزًا names the low, faint sound whose presence is being tested.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 38:3 supplies the contrast of a cry from destroyed earlier generations before the focus's final question.
branch_activations.activation: The cry meets the focus through the sound-object رِكْزًا, whose low intensity lowers the endpoint from any outcry to even the faintest audible trace.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The final silence is calibrated to a minimal signal: not simply no speech, but no faint sound from them.
branch_activations.boundary: This concerns sound intensity and detectability; it does not claim a literal whisper or activate the separate planting/burial senses of the root.
